description: P32 (plan M6-M9 sections 2.10 and 5.11): a crewed ballista draws for 1.6 s behind an aim line that follows the giant for the first 60 % of the draw and then freezes; the bolt flies straight at 60 m/s to the point the line froze on, so a step aside after the freeze dodges it. It strikes as an 8 m attacker (attacker_height_override_m): its 140 poise reaches a stage-4 giant as about 102 (a stagger), a stage-5 one as 77 and a stage-6 one as 59 (two bolts); the damage keeps size_policy none. P39 (M9 balance, iteration 1): power 90 -> 60 (the poise stays: plan decision 21, a bolt staggers a stage-4 giant). Range 20-140 m, reload 6 s (the engine's record).
